purpose: Assess only whether the validated L03 context-place label utterance candidate is eligible for a later scoped productivity decision.

eligibility_proposals.subject: SCOPE
eligibility_proposals.boundary: No locative proposition or universal HNK claim.

eligibility_proposals.subject: REALIZATIONS
eligibility_proposals.boundary: Preserve both lexical authorities as FROZEN; no new forms or tokens.

eligibility_proposals.subject: GRAMMATICAL_LIMITS
eligibility_proposals.boundary: No in/at/to/from inference and no universal bare-lexical rule.

eligibility_proposals.subject: CURRICULUM_DEPENDENCY
eligibility_proposals.boundary: Productivity eligibility alone cannot map or author curriculum.

eligibility_proposals.subject: NEXT_STEP
eligibility_proposals.boundary: Do not promote under the eligibility approval.
